local M = {}
local Robot = {}
Robot.__index = Robot

function Robot.new(name)
  local self = setmetatable({}, Robot)
  self.name = name or "r"
  self.pos = { x = 0, y = 0 }
  return self
end

function Robot:move(cmds)
  for c in cmds:gmatch(".") do
    if c == "A" then self.pos.y = self.pos.y + 1
    elseif c == "L" or c == "R" then goto continue
    else error(("bad command %q"):format(c)) end
    ::continue::
  end
  return self
end

M.solve = function(t)
  local out = {}
  for i, v in ipairs(t) do out[#out + 1] = v * 2 end
  return out, select("#", ...)
end

return M
